name: @forge/digital-twin
description: FORGE digital twins: versioned twin documents linking a project to a physical device, the FORGE telemetry protocol (Arduino-friendly), an ingestion pipeline (sequence, duplicates, reordering, gaps, clock offset/drift, staleness), recordings and deterministic replay, simulation-versus-observation comparison, evidence-based twin designations, a deterministic synthetic adapter and an observation-only adapter boundary. Pure domain logic — no UI, no transport code.
